title: ÆTHER: Refreshing Sway v5 (one theme, one sound)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: ONE SONG, ONE THEME, ONE SOUND: this whole track is a single piece built on ONE catchy main hook that is heard in the first 8 seconds and keeps coming back all the way to the end, so every part clearly belongs to the same song. Never start a new song, never introduce a new unrelated melody, never change the band or the sound world. The same band plays from start to end, and the music develops only by adding or removing layers and by playing the same hook in slightly varied ways: answered, harmonised, ornamented, a little higher, fuller. A bright, refreshing, breezy, carefree instrumental in the style of modern South Indian film music, like a fresh morning drive along the coast. KEY AND TEMPO ARE FIXED: D major the whole time, 120 BPM with a light lilting swing, the beat steady from the first bar to the last, never stopping, no breaks, no pauses, no drops. THE BAND (the same throughout): a bamboo flute plays the main hook; a bright tumbi and a bouncy synth pluck play the same little answering riff after every hook phrase; a mandolin and a clean electric guitar strum lightly; a warm Rhodes holds the chords; a soft sparkling arpeggiator; tabla and dholak with a crisp modern drum layer (tight kick, finger snaps, light hi-hats) and a deep round bass. The acoustic instruments (flute, tumbi, mandolin, violin, santoor, tabla, dholak) sound natural, dry and close, played by hand, no echo or delay on them, never chopped or reversed. How it grows, always the same hook: first the flute plays the hook over light tabla and Rhodes, with the tumbi and synth pluck answering; then the full groove joins and the hook repeats with the mandolin and guitar strumming; then a short middle part where the violin and santoor play a variation of the same hook while the groove keeps going; then the hook returns, now played by flute and synth lead together in harmony, fullest and brightest; it ends on the hook one last time and a clean final hit on D. Keep it refreshing all the way: not a movie background, not a cinematic score, no big string swells, no choir, no slow emotional section, no medley, no new themes, no echo, no EDM drop, no side-chain pumping, no silence anywhere.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 09:15: every 10-second part of v3/v4 is good on its own, but nothing is interconnected; 'it is like jumping from one song to another song', even with a good transition. Cause: our briefs give a NEW lead, melody or idea every 10-14 s, so the model writes a medley. v5 is one continuous take built on ONE hook and ONE fixed band from start to end; sections only add or drop layers and vary the same hook. Keeps v3 take 2's sound and groove (D major, 120 BPM, traditional instruments natural + modern sounds), which he liked. Prompt mode (music_v2).

story: A fresh, breezy morning: the same six-part journey and steady 6/8 sway Jithesh liked in First Love v7, now as a refreshing track, not a romance.
